findings.summary: node_timeout=600 basis relies on GT-18 engine-kill times (30.5-39.9s) and GT-15 TIMEOUT death (904s) rather than a committed whole-tick timings.totalMs measurement at scale. The TickTimings instrumentation is introduced by this package, so no prior whole-tick p95/max reading exists; the 390s dr-triage max cited in the comment is a per-worker-result latency (G6 measurement), a component rather than a whole tick. This is acceptable under spec §1.1's escape hatch (raising the engine ceiling is the correct fix when legitimate tick work can exceed 30s, provided measured evidence is given): 判据 2b performs a live seed-board --run measurement asserting elapsed < node_timeout/2 with readable timings, and the GT-18/GT-15/G6 evidence is documented with provenance. Recording as a note, not a blocker, because all required discriminating tests exist and drive the real subject, and the value is finite with loud-failure semantics preserved.
